# axm agents remove

Remove coding-agent harnesses and clean up AXM-managed artifacts

## When to use

Remove coding-agent harnesses and clean up AXM-managed artifacts

## Usage

```bash
axm agents remove [flags] <id...>
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type   | Required | Description                             |
| ---- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `id` | string | Yes      | Configured coding-agent ID(s) to remove |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                               |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Remove agents from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Apply without confirmation                                                                |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Apply even if the plan has unresolved warnings                                            |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would change without applying                                                   |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove Cursor from this workspace**

```bash
axm agents remove cursor
```

**Preview managed artifact cleanup**

```bash
axm agents remove cursor --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
